intro: Cooking what I love, for the people I love.
description: I’m Zhalae. I learned to cook from my dad, and I cook just like him: by eye, by taste, and with the people I love in mind.
dadHeading: It all starts with my dad.
dadStory: My dad is the influence behind everything I cook. He taught me a way of cooking that has very little to do with following a recipe and everything to do with making food you love, for people you love.
instinctHeading: A little of this. A little more of that.
instinctStory: Like him, I mostly eyeball everything. I taste, adjust, and go with what feels right. Ask me exactly how much I added, and the honest answer is probably “until it tasted good.”
recipeStory: Most of the dishes here don’t have written recipes yet, because I haven’t been measuring as I go. Think of this as a look at what’s on my table: the things I make, photograph, and want to make again. Some recipes are coming soon. I just have to remember to write things down.
